exercises.explanationUz: There are three windows — “uçta deraza bor”; in my room — “mening xonamda”.
exercises.source: There are three windows in my room.

exercises.explanationUz: Mehmonxonada katta divan bor. — There is a big sofa in the living room.
exercises.source: Mehmonxonada katta divan bor.
accepted: There is a big sofa in the living room.

exercises.explanationUz: Oşxonamizda uçta deraza bor. — There are three windows in our kitchen.
exercises.source: Oşxonamizda uçta deraza bor.
accepted: There are three windows in our kitchen.

exercises.explanationUz: “three chairs” köplik, şuning uçun There are kerak.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: There is three chairs in the kitchen.
There are three chairs in the kitchen.
There three chairs are in the kitchen.
There are a three chairs in the kitchen.

exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida, on — ustida, in — içida, under — ostida.
exercises.text: The shoes are ___ the door. The cup is ___ the table. My mother is ___ the kitchen. The cat sleeps ___ the chair.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: There is a lamp in my bedroom.
There are a sofa in the living room.
There are two bedrooms in the flat.
There isn’t a computer in my room.
exercises.explanationUz: Birlik → there is (a lamp, a sofa); köplik → there are (two bedrooms, five rooms). Inkor: there isn’t.

exercises.text: My school bag is ___ the chair. The kitchen is ___ to the bathroom. A picture of my family is ___ the wall.
exercises.explanationUz: under — ostida; next to — yonida; on the wall — devorda.

exercises.source: Kitoblar stol ostida.
accepted: The books are under the table
The books are under the table.

exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va söroq gap — any.
exercises.text: We have ___ bread for breakfast. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ eggs at home? I want ___ tea with sugar.

exercises.explanationUz: Countable — sanaladigan (an egg, two apples, three potatoes); uncountable — sanalmaydigan (rice, meat, sugar).
“eggs” sanaladigan köplik, şuning uçun how many.
exercises.question: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?

isn’t any — “yöq”; in the fridge — “muzlatgiçda”.

accepted: There is some bread and there are some eggs on the table.

exercises.explanationUz: Şörvada göşt yöq. — There isn’t any meat in the soup.

accepted: There isn’t any meat in the soup.

exercises.explanationUz: bread, water, rice, cheese — sanalmaydigan; egg, apple — sanaladigan.

exercises.question: Which words are uncountable?
exercises.explanationUz: Milk, rice, water — sanalmaydi (two milks deyilmaydi). Apple, egg — sanaladi: two apples, ten eggs.

exercises.text: There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. We buy ___ meat at the market. Are there ___ apples in the bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va söroq gapda — any; tasdiq gapda — some.

exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “turn left at the crossing”, “next to the blue gate”; we → were.

exercises.statement: Bekzod is eleven years old.
exercises.evidence: I have a new friend in my class. His name is Bekzod. He is twelve.

exercises.text: Samir says: My ___ is Samir. There are ___ desks in his classroom. His new ___ is Bekzod.

exercises.question: What does Dilnoza’s mother look like?
options: She is tall and has long black hair.
She is short with grey hair.
She has got a big red bag.
She has got a blue bike.

exercises.statement: Dilnoza has two brothers.
exercises.evidence: My family is not big: there are five people in it — my mother, my father, my little brother, my grandmother and me.

exercises.statement: Dilnoza’s father has got a blue bike.
exercises.evidence: He is short, he is quiet, and he has got a blue bike.

exercises.text: I ___ a student. She ___ a teacher. They ___ my friends. The book ___ on the desk.
exercises.explanationUz: I bilan am, yagona şaxs va narsa bilan is, you/we/they hamda köplik bilan are işlatiladi.

exercises.text: I ___ late. We ___ in Class Eight.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor uçun to be dan keyin not qöyiladi: am not, is not (isn’t), are not (aren’t).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My name is Aziza and I am twelve.”
exercises.explanationUz: “My name is ...” — “Mening ismim ...”. To be fe’li özbekçada qöşimça bilan ifodalanadi.
“Bu mening kitobim” = This is my book. Bu yerda is albatta kerak.

exercises.text: My name ___ Samir. I ___ eleven years old. Nurina and Bekzod ___ my friends.
exercises.explanationUz: My name — u (it) → is; I → am; Nurina and Bekzod — ular (they) → are.

exercises.text: I ___ a little brother. My sister ___ long hair. We ___ two cats.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — have got; he / she / it — has got.

exercises.text: This is ___ mother and father (bizning). Rustam has a bike. ___ bike is blue. That girl is kind. ___ name is Aziza.
exercises.explanationUz: Onaga tegişli narsa — her, otaga — his, bizga — our, öquvçilarga — their.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My grandmother's garden is small and she has got two cats.”
exercises.explanationUz: 'My grandmother's garden' — bibimning boği, she has got — uning ... bor.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “U yoş va uning uzun soçi bor.”
exercises.explanationUz: Yoş — to be bilan, soç — has got bilan: She is young and she has got long hair.

exercises.text: Sanjar ___ got a big red bag. ___ name is Sanjar. My parents ___ got a small flat.
exercises.explanationUz: Sanjar (he) → has got; öğil bolaning ismi → His name; my parents (they) → have got.

exercises.text: I ___ to school every day (go). My brother ___ his homework at five (do). She ___ TV in the evening (watch).
exercises.explanationUz: He / she / it bilan fe’lga -s qöşiladi: goes, does, watches.

exercises.text: My father ___ work on Sunday. I ___ watch TV in the morning.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — don’t; he / she / it — doesn’t.

exercises.question: I get up ___ half past six.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat bilan at: at half past six. Kun bilan on, kunduz qismi bilan in.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “She does her homework in the evening.”
exercises.explanationUz: “She does her homework” — u uy vazifasini qiladi; “in the evening” — keçqurun.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Biz odatda soat yettida keçki ovqat qilamiz.”
exercises.explanationUz: Keçki ovqat — have dinner; soat yettida — at seven o’clock.

exercises.text: Aziza ___ up at half past six. She ___ hot tea for breakfast. Her friends ___ to school with her.
exercises.explanationUz: Aziza / she → wakes, drinks (-s bilan); her friends (they) → walk (-s siz).

exercises.text: ___ a big sofa in our living room. ___ four chairs in the kitchen. ___ a lamp on the desk. ___ two cats under the table.
exercises.explanationUz: Bitta narsa — There is; ikki yoki köp narsa — There are.

exercises.question: The cat sleeps ___ the bed.
exercises.explanationUz: Muşuk karavotning ostida — under (“ostida”).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “There are three windows in my room.”
exercises.explanationUz: There are three windows — “uçta deraza bor”; in my room — “mening xonamda”.
Joy sözi ingliz tilida fe’ldan keyin keladi: are under the table.

exercises.text: The shoes are ___ the door. The cup is ___ the table. My mother is ___ the kitchen. The cat sleeps ___ the chair.
exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida, on — ustida, in — içida, under — ostida.

exercises.text: My school bag is ___ the chair. The kitchen is ___ to the bathroom. A picture of my family is ___ the wall.
exercises.explanationUz: under — ostida; next to — yonida; on the wall — devorda.

exercises.text: We have ___ bread for breakfast. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ eggs at home? I want ___ tea with sugar.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va söroq gap — any.

exercises.question: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?
exercises.explanationUz: “eggs” sanaladigan köplik, şuning uçun how many.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “There isn’t any milk in the fridge.”
exercises.explanationUz: isn’t any — “yöq”; in the fridge — “muzlatgiçda”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men ovqat pişirişni yoqtiraman.”
exercises.explanationUz: yoqtiraman = like, pişiriş = cooking (like’den keyin -ing).

exercises.text: I ate ___ banana. Are there ___ tomatoes in the salad? There isn’t ___ cheese at home. We need ___ rice for lunch.

exercises.text: There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. We buy ___ meat at the market. Are there ___ apples in the bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va söroq gapda — any; tasdiq gapda — some.

exercises.text: I ___ swim, but I ___ dance. My brother ___ play football very well. ___ you ride a bike?
exercises.explanationUz: Ma’no ijobiy bölsa — can, qila olmaslik bölsa — can’t.

exercises.question: My cousin ___ play the guitar.
exercises.explanationUz: “can”dan keyin fe’l öz şaklida: can play.

exercises.text: I ___ going to ride a bike. He ___ going to play basketball. We ___ going to the park. ___ you going to watch a film?
exercises.explanationUz: I — am; u (he) — is; we — are; söroqda are.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “She isn’t going to play basketball this weekend.”
exercises.explanationUz: isn’t going to — “bormoqçi emas”; this weekend — “şu hafta oxirida”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men yaxşi suza olaman.”
exercises.explanationUz: “qila olaman” = I can + fe’l; “yaxşi” (well) — qöşimça ma’noni yetkazadi.

exercises.text: Sardor ___ play football very well. His sister ___ swim. On Saturday Sardor and Farrukh ___ going to watch a film.
exercises.explanationUz: Sardor futbolni yaxşi öynay oladi (can); singlisi suza olmaydi (can’t); ikki kişi (they) → are going to.

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Saturday. I ___ at the bus stop. My friends ___ on the metro. The ticket ___ cheap.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; we / you / they — were.

exercises.question: My brother and I ___ at the airport yesterday.
exercises.explanationUz: “My brother and I” — ikki kişi (they), şuning uçun were.

exercises.text: The bus stop is ___ the gate. The airport is not ___ — it is near. Go ___ ahead and turn ___ at the crossing.
exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida; far — uzoq; straight ahead — töğri; turn left — çapga.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?”
exercises.explanationUz: “how do I get to” — “... qanday boraman”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Keça men uyda edim.”
exercises.explanationUz: keça — yesterday, men — I, edim — was.

exercises.text: Go straight ahead and turn ___ at the crossing. The museum is ___ to the blue gate. Last weekend we ___ in Samarkand.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “turn left at the crossing”, “next to the blue gate”; we → were.

exercises.question: How old is Samir?
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “I am eleven years old.” (Bekzod ön ikki yoşda, uni aralaştirmang.)

exercises.text: Samir says: My ___ is Samir. There are ___ desks in his classroom. His new ___ is Bekzod.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: name / twenty / friend — barçasi matnda sözma-söz bor.

exercises.question: How many people are there in Dilnoza’s family?
exercises.explanationUz: “there are five people in it — my mother, my father, my little brother, my grandmother and me.”

exercises.text: Dilnoza’s mother is ___ and she has long ___ hair. Sanjar has got a big ___ bag.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: tall, black, red — uçala söz ham matnda bor.

exercises.question: What time does school start?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragrafda: “School starts at eight o’clock.”

exercises.question: Which subject does Aziza like most?
exercises.explanationUz: “My favourite subject is English.”

exercises.text: Aziza wakes up at ___ past six. She is never ___ at school. In the afternoon she does her ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: half, late, homework — matndagi sözlar.

exercises.question: How many rooms are there in the flat?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “There are five rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.”

exercises.question: Where is the school bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragraf: “my school bag is under the chair”.

exercises.text: There are five rooms in my flat. My school bag is ___ the chair. A picture is ___ the wall. There ___ no computers in our rooms, but there ___ a soft sofa in the living room.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda “five rooms” deyilgan — are; sumka stul ostida — under; rasm devor ustida — on; “computers” köplik — böş joyga are (söz “There” allaqaçon yozilgan).

exercises.text: We need ___ food for the weekend. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ apples in the bag? I like ___ soup.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va söroq — any; like’den keyin — cooking.

exercises.question: What can Sardor do very well?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “I can play football very well.”

exercises.text: Sardor ___ ride a bike for two hours. His sister can’t ___. On Sunday he ___ going to ride bikes in the hills with his father.
exercises.explanationUz: Qobiliyat — can / can’t; reja — am going to.

exercises.question: How does the writer go to school every day?

exercises.question: How long were they on the train?

exercises.question: What food is already on the table?

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Past Simple şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Töğri fe’llarga -ed qöşiladi: visit → visited, cook → cooked, watch → watched, play → played.
exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.

exercises.explanationUz: Undoş + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i böladi: study → studied.
exercises.question: What is the past form of “study”?

exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda did not (didn’t) dan keyin fe’l -ed siz keladi: didn’t watch, didn’t clean.
exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.

exercises.instructionUz: Grammatik jihatdan töğri söroq gapni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: Söroqda did işlatiladi va asosiy fe’l boşlanğiç şaklda qoladi: Did you visit …?
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: Sözlardan töğri tartibda söroq gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz: Tartib: Wh-söz + did + ega + fe’l + qolgan qism: Where did you go last weekend?

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Didn’t enjoy” — inkor: “yoqmadi / zavqlanmadi”. Last Sunday = ötgan yakşanba.
exercises.source: We didn’t enjoy the film last Sunday.

exercises.explanationUz: Ötgan dam oliş kunlari Buxorodagi bobom va buvimnikiga bordik. — Last weekend we visited our grandparents in Bukhara.
exercises.source: Ötgan dam oliş kunlari Buxorodagi bobom va buvimnikiga bordik.
accepted: Last weekend we visited our grandparents in Bukhara.

exercises.explanationUz: Opam keça imtihoniga tayyorlandi. — My sister studied for her exam yesterday.
exercises.source: Opam keça imtihoniga tayyorlandi.
accepted: My sister studied for her exam yesterday.

exercises.instructionUz: Past Simple’da töğri yozilgan gaplarni belgilang.
exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: “Did she cooked” — did bilan -ed qöşilmaydi; “studyed” — töğrisi studied.

exercises.instructionUz: Har böşliq uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother. We ___ watch TV. ___ you call her too?
exercises.explanationUz: Yesterday — ötgan zamon: visited; inkorda didn’t; söroqda Did.

exercises.instructionUz: Malikaning şanba kunini voqealar tartibida joylaştiring.
exercises.question: Matndagi voqealar ketma-ketligi.
items: They arrived by train at ten o’clock.
They visited the Registan.
Dilnoza’s mother cooked plov.
The girls talked until midnight.
itemsShuffled: Dilnoza’s mother cooked plov.
The girls talked until midnight.
They arrived by train at ten o’clock.
They visited the Registan.
exercises.explanationUz: Ertalab yetib kelişdi → kunduzi Registon → keçqurun palov → yarim tungaça suhbat.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Uç kun oldin” = three days ago — ago vaqtdan keyin keladi. Fe’l Past Simple’da: visited.
exercises.source: Men uç kun oldin buvimnikiga bordim.
accepted: I visited my grandmother three days ago
I visited my grandma three days ago
Three days ago I visited my grandmother
I visited my granny three days ago

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joyga mos vaqt iborasini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “Ago” vaqtdan keyin keladi: two weeks ago. “Last” esa vaqtdan oldin: last week.
exercises.question: I started this course two weeks ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Fe’llarni ötgan zamon qöşimçasi böyiça saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: arrived, danced; carried, tried; planned, dropped.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi notöğri fe’llarni ötgan zamon şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, give → gave — bu şakllar yod olinadi.
exercises.text: Yesterday we ___ (go) to the zoo. We ___ (see) a big lion. We ___ (eat) ice cream and my uncle ___ (give) me a balloon.

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joylarga was yoki were qöying.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; you / we / they — were.
exercises.text: When I ___ six, my sister ___ ten. We ___ always together and our parents ___ very happy.

exercises.explanationUz: Did bilan fe’l boşlanğiç şaklda: Did you have …? “Did you had” — xato.
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: To be fe’li bilan töğri tuzilgan söroqni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: Was / were bilan söroqda did işlatilmaydi: Were you happy?
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.explanationUz: When + ega + was …, ega + fe’l: When I was seven I got a bike.
“Made a kite for me” — “menga varrak yasab berdi”.
exercises.source: My grandfather made a kite for me.

exercises.source: Bolaligimda biz qişloqda yaşardik.
accepted: When I was a child, we lived in a village.

exercises.explanationUz: Har yozi daryoga borib, çömilardik. — Every summer we went to the river and swam.
exercises.source: Har yozi daryoga borib, çömilardik.
accepted: Every summer we went to the river and swam.

exercises.instructionUz: Notöğri (irregular) fe’llarning töğri ötgan zamon şakllarini belgilang.
exercises.question: Which past forms are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: see → saw, make → made. “seed”, “maked” — xato.

exercises.text: When I ___ seven, we ___ to Tashkent. ___ you happy there?
exercises.explanationUz: I → was; ötgan zamon: moved; you → Were you …?
play, climb, remember — -ed bilan; swim, tell, break — alohida şakl.

exercises.instructionUz: Akmal bilan bölgan voqeani tartib bilan joylaştiring.
exercises.question: Matndagi voqea ketma-ketligi.
items: The children climbed the trees.
Akmal fell from a tree.
He broke his arm.
The neighbour took him to the doctor.
itemsShuffled: He broke his arm.
The neighbour took him to the doctor.
The children climbed the trees.
Akmal fell from a tree.
exercises.explanationUz: Daraxtga çiqişdi → Akmal yiqildi → qöli sindi → qöşni şifokorga olib bordi.

exercises.text: I ___ (not see) the film. He ___ (not take) his umbrella. It ___ (not be) cold.

exercises.explanationUz: “Bolaligimda” = When I was a child; yaşardik — lived (Past Simple).
exercises.source: Bolaligimda biz qişloqda yaşardik.
accepted: When I was a child we lived in a village
When I was a child, we lived in a village
We lived in a village when I was a child

exercises.explanationUz: cheap → cheaper, big → bigger (undoş ikkilanadi), easy → easier (y → i).
exercises.text: Fruit is ___ (cheap) in the village. My flat is ___ (big) than yours. This test is ___ (easy) than the last one.

exercises.explanationUz: Expensive — uzun sifat, şuning uçun more expensive.
exercises.question: A taxi is ___ than a bus.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni darajasi böyiça tartiblang: oddiy → qiyosiy → orttirma.
exercises.question: good sözining darajalari.
items: good
better
the best
itemsShuffled: the best
good
better
exercises.explanationUz: good → better → the best (notöğri sifat).
the biggest, the most beautiful, the best (good — notöğri sifat).
exercises.text: Tashkent is ___ (big) city in Uzbekistan. Registan is ___ (beautiful) place in Samarkand. This is ___ (good) café in our street.

exercises.explanationUz: bad → worse → the worst. “Badder” yoki “more bad” deyilmaydi.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The traffic is more bad today.

exercises.explanationUz: ega + is + qiyosiy sifat + than + …
Qişloqdagi hayot şahardagidan tinçroq. — Life in the village is quieter than life in the city.
exercises.source: Qişloqdagi hayot şahardagidan tinçroq.
accepted: Life in the village is quieter than life in the city.

exercises.explanationUz: Metro taksidan tezroq va arzonroq. — The metro is faster and cheaper than a taxi.
exercises.source: Metro taksidan tezroq va arzonroq.
accepted: The metro is faster and cheaper than a taxi.

exercises.explanationUz: “-roq” = qiyosiy daraja: quieter than.
exercises.source: Qişloq şahardan tinçroq.
accepted: The village is quieter than the city
A village is quieter than a city
Village is quieter than the city
The countryside is quieter than the city

exercises.explanationUz: “The most crowded” — “eng gavjum”.
exercises.source: This is the most crowded street in the city.
accepted: Bu şahardagi eng odam gavjum köça

exercises.instructionUz: Töğri yozilgan qiyosiy / orttirma şakllarni belgilang.
exercises.question: Which forms are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: cheap → cheaper (more cheap emas), good → better (gooder emas).

exercises.text: The metro is faster ___ the bus. It is ___ fastest way to travel. A taxi is ___ expensive.
exercises.explanationUz: Qiyosda than; orttirmada the; uzun sifat oldidan more.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni qiyosiy darajasi qanday yasalişiga qarab saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: cheaper, quieter, safer; more expensive, more modern, more crowded.

exercises.instructionUz: “as … as” tuzilmasi töğri işlatilgan gapni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Teng emaslikni bildiriş: not as + sifat + as. Sifat oddiy şaklda qoladi.

options: Bukhara is not as bigger as Tashkent.
Bukhara is not as big as Tashkent.
Bukhara is not so big than Tashkent.
Bukhara is not as big than Tashkent.

exercises.explanationUz: I — am going to; she — is going to; we / they — are going to.

options: She will to go to Bukhara.

exercises.question: The phone is ringing. — “Don’t worry, I ___ answer it!”

exercises.explanationUz: Will inkori — won’t; be going to inkori — aren’t going to.
exercises.text: Don’t worry, I ___ be late. We ___ going to stay at a hotel.

We are going to go to Samarkand in summer
In summer we are going to visit Samarkand
We are going to visit Samarkand in the summer
We are going to go to Samarkand in the summer

accepted: This summer we are going to visit our relatives in Khiva.

accepted: I think it will be very hot in July.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: I’m going to visit my aunt.

items: They are going to take the night train on Friday.

exercises.question: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.

exercises.explanationUz: Reja: are going to; fikr: will be; hozirgi qaror / taklif: I’ll lend.

exercises.text: I ___ been to Bukhara. My sister ___ visited Turkey. My parents ___ never flown.

exercises.text: Have you ever ___ (see) the sea? I have never ___ (eat) Indian food. She has ___ (fly) to Moscow twice.

options: I haven’t never been to Dubai.
I have never been to Dubai.

I have ever been to Dubai.

We've just arrived at the airport

accepted: Have you ever been abroad? — Yes, I have. I went to Kazakhstan last summer.

accepted: My grandmother has never flown on a plane.

accepted: Mening buvim heç qaçon samolyotda uçmagan

exercises.instructionUz: Vaqt sözlarini qaysi zamon bilan işlatilişiga qarab saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ever / never / yet — tajriba va natija (Present Perfect); aniq ötgan vaqt — Past Simple.

exercises.question: Ikki döst tajriba haqida gaplaşmoqda.
items: Have you ever been to Istanbul?

Did you like it?
Yes, it was beautiful!
itemsShuffled: Did you like it?
Yes, it was beautiful!
Have you ever been to Istanbul?
Yes, I have. I went there last spring.
exercises.explanationUz: Avval Present Perfect bilan tajriba söraladi, keyin tafsilot Past Simple bilan.
Aniq vaqt (last year) bilan Past Simple: I went to Turkey last year.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have been to Turkey last year.
I went to Turkey last year.
I have went to Turkey last year.
I have go to Turkey last year.

exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect töğri işlatilgan gaplarni belgilang.
exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: “have went” — 3-şakl gone bölişi kerak; “in 2021” — aniq vaqt, Past Simple kerak.

exercises.text: You have a headache. You ___ drink some water. You ___ play computer games all night.

exercises.explanationUz: Should dan keyin to işlatilmaydi: You should see a doctor.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: You should to see a doctor.

exercises.explanationUz: I / we / they — have to; he / she — has to.
exercises.text: I ___ get up at six. My sister ___ take her medicine. We ___ wear a uniform at school.

exercises.explanationUz: Should + ega + fe’l + …: Should I stay in bed?

exercises.source: Siz köproq uxlaşingiz kerak.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: He should to see a doctor.

exercises.source: Isitmangiz bor. Uyda qolib, dam olişingiz kerak.
accepted: You have a fever. You should stay at home and rest.

exercises.explanationUz: Bu dorini ovqatdan keyin içişingiz şart. — You must take this medicine after meals.
exercises.source: Bu dorini ovqatdan keyin içişingiz şart.
accepted: You must take this medicine after meals.

exercises.instructionUz: Şifokor qabulidagi dialogni tartib bilan joylaştiring.

items: What’s the matter?
I have a bad headache.
You should rest and drink water.
Do I have to take medicine?
No, you don’t have to.
itemsShuffled: You should rest and drink water.
No, you don’t have to.
What’s the matter?
Do I have to take medicine?
I have a bad headache.

exercises.question: In the hospital: “You ___ use your phone in this room.” (It is not allowed.)

exercises.explanationUz: “Doesn’t have to” — “şart emas”.

accepted: Unga ertaga maktabga boriş şart emas
U ertaga maktabga borişi şart emas

exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.
exercises.explanationUz: Töğri fe’llarga -ed qöşiladi: visit → visited, cook → cooked, watch → watched, play → played.

exercises.question: What is the past form of “study”?
exercises.explanationUz: Undoş + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i böladi: study → studied.

exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda did not (didn’t) dan keyin fe’l -ed siz keladi: didn’t watch, didn’t clean.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men uç kun oldin buvimnikiga bordim.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Uç kun oldin” = three days ago — ago vaqtdan keyin keladi. Fe’l Past Simple’da: visited.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “We didn’t enjoy the film last Sunday.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Didn’t enjoy” — inkor: “yoqmadi / zavqlanmadi”. Last Sunday = ötgan yakşanba.

exercises.question: I started this course two weeks ___.
exercises.explanationUz: “Ago” vaqtdan keyin keladi: two weeks ago. “Last” esa vaqtdan oldin: last week.

exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother. We ___ watch TV. ___ you call her too?
exercises.explanationUz: Yesterday — ötgan zamon: visited; inkorda didn’t; söroqda Did.

exercises.text: Yesterday we ___ (go) to the zoo. We ___ (see) a big lion. We ___ (eat) ice cream and my uncle ___ (give) me a balloon.
exercises.explanationUz: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, give → gave — bu şakllar yod olinadi.

exercises.text: When I ___ six, my sister ___ ten. We ___ always together and our parents ___ very happy.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; you / we / they — were.

exercises.question: Which question is correct?
exercises.explanationUz: Was / were bilan söroqda did işlatilmaydi: Were you happy?

exercises.text: I ___ (not see) the film. He ___ (not take) his umbrella. It ___ (not be) cold.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda didn’t + boşlanğiç şakl: didn’t see, didn’t take. To be bilan: wasn’t.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Bolaligimda biz qişloqda yaşardik.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Bolaligimda” = When I was a child; yaşardik — lived (Past Simple).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My grandfather made a kite for me.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Made a kite for me” — “menga varrak yasab berdi”.

exercises.text: When I ___ seven, we ___ to Tashkent. ___ you happy there?
exercises.explanationUz: I → was; ötgan zamon: moved; you → Were you …?

exercises.text: Fruit is ___ (cheap) in the village. My flat is ___ (big) than yours. This test is ___ (easy) than the last one.
exercises.explanationUz: cheap → cheaper, big → bigger (undoş ikkilanadi), easy → easier (y → i).

exercises.question: A taxi is ___ than a bus.
exercises.explanationUz: Expensive — uzun sifat, şuning uçun more expensive.

exercises.text: Tashkent is ___ (big) city in Uzbekistan. Registan is ___ (beautiful) place in Samarkand. This is ___ (good) café in our street.
exercises.explanationUz: the biggest, the most beautiful, the best (good — notöğri sifat).
“-roq” = qiyosiy daraja: quieter than.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “This is the most crowded street in the city.”
exercises.explanationUz: “The most crowded” — “eng gavjum”.

exercises.text: The metro is faster ___ the bus. It is ___ fastest way to travel. A taxi is ___ expensive.
exercises.explanationUz: Qiyosda than; orttirmada the; uzun sifat oldidan more.

exercises.text: I ___ going to pack my bag. My sister ___ going to buy the tickets. We ___ going to leave at six.
exercises.explanationUz: I — am going to; she — is going to; we / they — are going to.

exercises.question: The phone is ringing. — “Don’t worry, I ___ answer it!”
exercises.explanationUz: Hozir qabul qilingan qaror (telefon jiringladi) — will: I’ll answer it.

exercises.question: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
exercises.explanationUz: Qora bulutlar — dalil. Bunday başorat uçun be going to: It is going to rain.

exercises.text: Don’t worry, I ___ be late. We ___ going to stay at a hotel.
exercises.explanationUz: Will inkori — won’t; be going to inkori — aren’t going to.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Biz yozda Samarqandga bormoqçimiz.”
exercises.explanationUz: Oldindan reja — be going to: We are going to visit Samarkand.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “I think it will be sunny tomorrow.”
exercises.explanationUz: “I think it will …” — “Menimça, … böladi”.

exercises.text: We ___ going to travel to Khiva. I think it ___ be hot. Oh, you forgot your hat? I ___ lend you mine!
exercises.explanationUz: Reja: are going to; fikr: will be; hozirgi qaror / taklif: I’ll lend.

exercises.text: I ___ been to Bukhara. My sister ___ visited Turkey. My parents ___ never flown.
exercises.explanationUz: I / we / they — have; he / she / it — has.

exercises.text: Have you ever ___ (see) the sea? I have never ___ (eat) Indian food. She has ___ (fly) to Moscow twice.
exercises.explanationUz: see → seen, eat → eaten, fly → flown.

exercises.question: I haven’t packed my suitcase ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Yet — inkor va söroq gap oxirida: I haven’t finished yet.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Biz hozirgina aeroportga yetib keldik.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Hozirgina” = just, have va fe’l orasida: I have just arrived.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My grandmother has never flown on a plane.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Has never flown” — “heç qaçon uçmagan”.

exercises.text: ___ you ever been abroad? — No, I have ___ been abroad. My brother ___ flown to Moscow.
exercises.explanationUz: you — Have; inkor ma’no — never; my brother (he) — has.

exercises.text: You have a headache. You ___ drink some water. You ___ play computer games all night.
exercises.explanationUz: Foydali iş — should; zararli iş — shouldn’t.

exercises.text: I ___ get up at six. My sister ___ take her medicine. We ___ wear a uniform at school.
exercises.explanationUz: I / we / they — have to; he / she — has to.

exercises.question: In the hospital: “You ___ use your phone in this room.” (It is not allowed.)
exercises.explanationUz: Mustn’t — taqiq. Don’t have to — şart emas (ixtiyoriy).

exercises.question: It’s Sunday. You ___ get up early.
exercises.explanationUz: Dam oliş kuni erta turiş şart emas: You don’t have to get up early.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Siz köproq uxlaşingiz kerak.”
exercises.explanationUz: Maslahat — should: You should sleep more.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “He doesn’t have to go to school tomorrow.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Doesn’t have to” — “şart emas”.

exercises.text: You have a fever, so you ___ stay in bed. You ___ go to school. Tomorrow is Saturday, so you ___ get up early.
exercises.explanationUz: Majburiyat — must; taqiq — mustn’t; ixtiyoriy (şart emas) — don’t have to.

exercises.text: We have ___ eggs, but we don’t have ___ milk. Are there ___ onions in the kitchen?
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiqda some; inkor va söroqda any.

exercises.question: How ___ sugar do you want in your tea?
exercises.explanationUz: Sugar — sanalmaydigan, şuning uçun How much.

exercises.question: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?
exercises.explanationUz: Eggs — sanaladigan köplik, şuning uçun How many.

exercises.text: Please buy a ___ of potatoes, a ___ of oil and a ___ of bread.
exercises.explanationUz: a kilo of potatoes, a bottle of oil, a loaf of bread.
Inkorda any: There isn’t any milk.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Don’t put too much salt in the soup.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Too much salt” — “juda köp tuz”.

exercises.text: We need ___ flour for the bread. How ___ eggs have we got? There isn’t ___ butter.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq — some; eggs (sanaladigan) — How many; inkor — any.

exercises.question: How did Malika’s family travel to Samarkand?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragrafda: “… and arrived by train at ten o’clock.”

exercises.question: Why did they stay at home on Sunday morning?
exercises.explanationUz: Uçinçi paragrafda: ertalab yomğir yoğgani uçun ular uyda qolişgan.

exercises.text: On Saturday they ___ the Registan. The girls talked and ___ until midnight. Malika ___ dried apricots for her grandmother.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar matnda bor: visited, laughed, bought.

exercises.question: What was big at grandmother’s house?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “… the garden was huge.”

exercises.question: Who took Akmal to the doctor?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragraf: qöşnisi Akmalni eski maşinasida şifokorga olib borgan.

exercises.text: The children ___ the trees and ___ in the river. Akmal fell and ___ his arm.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: climbed, swam, broke — matnda sözma-söz bor.

exercises.text: The city is ___ and more crowded. The village is the ___ place Sardor knows. People are ___ in the village.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar matnda: noisier, quietest, friendlier.

exercises.question: How is the family going to travel from Tashkent?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: ular juma kuni tungi poyezdda jönaşadi.

exercises.text: The ___ says it will be ___ and hot. Zarina is going to ___ a hat and sunglasses.

exercises.question: What hasn’t Laylo done yet?

exercises.text: In Istanbul they went ___ every day. Laylo has ___ many foreign dishes. She brings home a small ___ from each country.

exercises.text: Teenagers need eight or nine hours of ___. Shoxrux should drink enough ___ and do some ___ after school.

exercises.text: Heat the oil and ___ the meat. Don’t ___ too much. Put the ___ in the middle of the rice.

exercises.explanationUz: “In Fergana there will be strong wind.”

exercises.text: In the mountains it will be about ___ degrees, so take a ___.
exercises.explanationUz: “In the mountains it will be cooler — about eighteen degrees — so take a jacket.”

exercises.explanationUz: Ona: “The flight to Seoul is about seven hours.”

exercises.explanationUz: Madina: “I’ll take two kilos, please. And have you got any cucumbers?”

exercises.explanationUz: relax — dam olmoq, hordiq çiqarmoq.

exercises.text: My parents ___ teachers.

“Bordingizmi?” — Did you go …?

exercises.text: My cousins ___ (come) to our house and we ___ (have) dinner together.

“arzonroq” = cheaper than.

exercises.text: My town is not ___ big ___ Tashkent.

exercises.question: She has the tickets. She ___ fly to Istanbul on Monday.

exercises.question: What does “forecast” mean?

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men sizga yordam beraman.”
exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgi qaror / taklif: I’ll help you.

exercises.text: They ___ going to buy a new car.

exercises.question: He ___ Bukhara three times.
exercises.explanationUz: He — has + 3-şakl: has visited.

exercises.question: What does “abroad” mean?
exercises.explanationUz: abroad — çet elda, çet elga.
“Heç … bölganmisiz?” = Have you ever been …?

exercises.text: Have you booked the hotel ___?
exercises.explanationUz: Söroq oxirida — yet.

exercises.question: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
exercises.explanationUz: Maslahat — should.

exercises.text: My mother ___ work at the hospital at night.
exercises.explanationUz: My mother (she) — has to.

exercises.question: What does “pharmacy” mean?
exercises.explanationUz: pharmacy — dorixona.

exercises.question: The museum is free. You ___ pay.
exercises.explanationUz: Bepul — tölaş şart emas: You don’t have to pay.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Bu yerda çekiş mumkin emas.”
exercises.explanationUz: Taqiq — mustn’t.

exercises.question: How ___ money have you got?

exercises.text: Is there ___ bread on the table?
exercises.explanationUz: Söroq — any.

exercises.question: What does “flour” mean?

exercises.explanationUz: “Neçta?” (sanaladigan) = How many …?

exercises.text: There aren’t ___ tomatoes and there isn’t ___ oil.
exercises.explanationUz: Tomatoes — sanaladigan: not many; oil — sanalmaydigan: not much.

exercises.question: You: That’s ___ mother. Her name is Dilnoza.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Erkak qarindoş — “brother” (aka/uka); “sister” — opa/singil. Töliq: “He’s my brother. He is a doctor.” — U mening akam. U şifokor.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: And the tall man?
exercises.question: You: He’s my ___. He is a doctor.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “I” bilan “have got” işlatiladi; “has got” — he/she uçun. Töliq: “Yes, I have got one sister. She is ten.” — Ha, bitta singlim bor. U ön yoşda.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Have you got any sisters?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___ got one sister. She is ten.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat bilan “at”: at seven o’clock, at 8:30. Töliq: “I usually get up at seven o’clock.” — Odatda soat yettida turaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: Let’s go to the library tomorrow. What time do you get up?
exercises.question: You: I usually get up ___ seven o’clock.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Present Simple, “I” bilan fe’l özgarmaydi: I have breakfast. Töliq: “I have breakfast at half past seven.” — Yetti yarimda nonuşta qilaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: And when do you have breakfast?
exercises.question: You: I ___ breakfast at half past seven.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Uçraşuv ertaga — “See you tomorrow”. Töliq: “Great! See you tomorrow.” — Zör! Ertaga körişgunça.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: OK. Let’s meet at nine.
exercises.question: You: Great! See you ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Biror narsa borligini söraş: Is there a…? / There is a… Töliq: “It’s nice. Is there a TV?” — Yaxşi ekan. Televizor bormi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: Welcome! This is the living room.
exercises.question: You: It’s nice. Is ___ a TV?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Sirt ustida — “on”: on the table. Içida — “in”: in the box. Töliq: “And where are the keys? Are they on the table?” — Kalitlar qayerda? Ular stol ustidami?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: Yes, there is. It’s next to the window.
exercises.question: You: And where are the keys? Are they ___ the table?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “bedrooms” — köplik, şuning uçun “are there”. Töliq: “How many bedrooms are there?” — Neçta yotoqxona bor?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: No, they are in the kitchen, in the drawer.
exercises.question: You: How many bedrooms ___ there?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Xuşmuomala sörov: “Can I have…, please?” Töliq: “Can I have a cup of tea, please?” — Bir piyola çoy olsam böladimi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Hello! What would you like?
exercises.question: You: ___ I have a cup of tea, please?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “sandwich” undoş tovuş bilan boşlanadi va sanaladi → a sandwich. Töliq: “Yes, I’d like a sandwich, please.” — Ha, bitta sendviç olaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Of course. Anything to eat?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I’d like ___ sandwich, please.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Narx söraş: “How much is it?” Töliq: “OK, some soup, then. How much is it?” — Mayli, unda şörva. Qança turadi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Sorry, we haven’t got any sandwiches today. We’ve got soup.
exercises.question: You: OK, some soup, then. How ___ is it?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Imkoniyat yöqligi “can’t” bilan: I can’t come. Töliq: “Sorry, I can’t come on Saturday. I work.” — Keçir, şanba kuni kela olmayman. Işlayman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: I’m going to watch a film on Saturday. Can you come?
exercises.question: You: Sorry, I ___ come on Saturday. I work.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Reja: be going TO + fe’l — I’m going to visit. Töliq: “Sunday is OK. I’m going to visit my grandmother in the morning, but I’m free in the evening.” — Yakşanba böladi. Ertalab buvimnikiga bormoqçiman, lekin keçqurun böşman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: What about Sunday?
exercises.question: You: Sunday is OK. I’m going ___ visit my grandmother in the morning, but I’m free in the evening.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: love / like dan keyin fe’l -ing bilan: I love watching… Töliq: “Yes, I love watching comedies!” — Ha, komediya körişni juda yaxşi köraman!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Great! Do you like comedies?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I love ___ comedies!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Joy söraş — “where”: Where is…? Töliq: “Excuse me, where is the railway station?” — Keçirasiz, temir yöl vokzali qayerda?
exercises.question: You: Excuse me, ___ is the railway station?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Aniq nuqtada buriliş — “at”: turn left at the bridge. Töliq: “Turn left at the bridge. OK.” — Köprikda çapga burilaman. Tuşunarli.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Passer-by: Go straight on and turn left at the bridge.
exercises.question: You: Turn left ___ the bridge. OK.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ötgan zamon, “I” bilan → was: I was lost. Töliq: “Is it far? Yesterday I was lost here!” — Uzoqmi? Keça şu yerda adaşib qolgandim!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Passer-by: Then the station is on your right, next to the museum.
exercises.question: You: Is it far? Yesterday I ___ lost here!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tugagan voqea — Past Simple: visit + -ed = visited. Töliq: “It was great, thanks. We visited Samarkand for a week.” — Zör ötdi, rahmat. Bir hafta Samarqandga borib keldik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Welcome back! How was your holiday?
exercises.question: You: It was great, thanks. We ___ Samarkand for a week.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Past Simple: walk → walked. Töliq: “We walked around the old city and took lots of photos.” — Eski şahar böylab sayr qildik va köp surat oldik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Lovely! What did you do there?
exercises.question: You: We ___ around the old city and took lots of photos.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Did you…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, I did / No, I didn’t. Töliq: “Yes, I did. The plov was amazing!” — Ha, yoqdi. Palov ajoyib edi!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Did you like the food?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___. The plov was amazing!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Bitta uy, ötgan zamon → was. Töliq: “I grew up in a small village. Our house was near a river.” — Kiçik qişloqda ösganman. Uyimiz daryo yonida edi.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: Where did you grow up?
exercises.question: You: I grew up in a small village. Our house ___ near a river.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: play → played (y dan oldin unli bölsa, -ed oddiy qöşiladi). Töliq: “We played football every day after school.” — Har kuni maktabdan keyin futbol öynardik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: What games did you play?
exercises.question: You: We ___ football every day after school.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “teach” — notöğri fe’l: teach → taught. Töliq: “Mr Karimov. He taught us a lot about nature.” — Karimov domla. U bizga tabiat haqida köp narsa örgatgan.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: Who was your favourite teacher?
exercises.question: You: Mr Karimov. He ___ us a lot about nature.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ikki narsani soliştiriş: qisqa sifat + -er → faster. Töliq: “To Bukhara. Which is faster, the train or the bus?” — Buxoroga. Qaysi biri tezroq: poyezdmi yoki avtobus?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: Good afternoon. Where are you travelling to?
exercises.question: You: To Bukhara. Which is ___, the train or the bus?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Uzun sifat bilan qiyos: more + sifat + than → more expensive than. Töliq: “Is it more expensive than the bus?” — U avtobusdan qimmatroqmi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: The fast train. It takes four hours.
exercises.question: You: Is it ___ expensive than the bus?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “return ticket” — borib-keliş; “single” — faqat bir tomonga. Töliq: “OK, one return ticket, please.” — Mayli, bitta borib-keliş çiptasi, iltimos.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: A little. A return ticket is 200,000 sums.
exercises.question: You: OK, one ___ ticket, please.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Oldindan qilingan reja: be going to + fe’l. Töliq: “I’m going to go hiking in the mountains.” — Toğda piyoda sayrga çiqmoqçiman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: What are your plans for the weekend?
exercises.question: You: I’m ___ to go hiking in the mountains.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Başorat (ob-havo) — will + fe’l: it will be sunny. Töliq: “They say it will be sunny on Saturday.” — Şanba kuni quyoşli bölişini aytişyapti.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Do you know the weather forecast?
exercises.question: You: They say it ___ be sunny on Saturday.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Şu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror yoki va’da — will: I’ll call you. Töliq: “Of course! I will call you tonight with the details.” — Albatta! Keçqurun qönğiroq qilib, tafsilotlarini aytaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Sounds great. Can I come too?
exercises.question: You: Of course! I ___ call you tonight with the details.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Have you ever…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, I have / No, I haven’t. Töliq: “Yes, I have. I worked at a hotel in Tashkent last year.” — Ha, işlaganman. Ötgan yili Toşkentdagi mehmonxonada işladim.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: Have you ever worked in a hotel?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___. I worked at a hotel in Tashkent last year.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va savolda “yet” — hali: not yet. Töliq: “Not yet. I finish next month.” — Hali yöq. Keyingi oy tugataman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: Good. Have you finished your English course?
exercises.question: You: Not ___. I finish next month.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “never” — heç qaçon: I’ve never used it. Töliq: “No, I’ve never used it, but I learn quickly.” — Yöq, heç foydalanmaganman, lekin tez örganaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: And have you used our booking system before?
exercises.question: You: No, I’ve ___ used it, but I learn quickly.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgaça davom etayotgan holat: have had … for three days. Töliq: “I have had a headache for three days.” — Uç kundan beri boşim oğriyapti.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: What’s the problem?
exercises.question: You: I ___ a headache for three days.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Maslahat söraş — should: What should I do? Töliq: “Not really. What should I do?” — Unçalik emas. Nima qilişim kerak?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: Do you sleep well? Do you drink enough water?
exercises.question: You: Not really. What ___ I do?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Majburiyat: have to + fe’l → Do I have to take…? Töliq: “Do I have to take any medicine?” — Biror dori içişim kerakmi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: You should sleep eight hours and drink more water. You mustn’t work late.
exercises.question: You: Do I have ___ take any medicine?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gapda — some: I need some tomatoes. Töliq: “Yes, please. I need some tomatoes and some rice.” — Ha, iltimos. Menga bir neçta pomidor va bir oz guruç kerak.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: Hello! Can I help you?
exercises.question: You: Yes, please. I need ___ tomatoes and some rice.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “rice” — sanalmaydi → how much; sanaladigan → how many. Töliq: “A kilo, please. And how much rice do I need for six people?” — Bir kilo, iltimos. Olti kişiga qança guruç kerak?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: How many tomatoes would you like?
exercises.question: You: A kilo, please. And how ___ rice do I need for six people?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: böş joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “a lot of” — köp (sanaladigan ham, sanalmaydigan ham). Töliq: “No, thanks. I’ve got a lot of onions at home.” — Yöq, rahmat. Uyda piyoz köp.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: About one kilo. Do you need any onions?
exercises.question: You: No, thanks. I’ve got a ___ of onions at home.
